title: Knobby Irish Haddock Toast
description: A traditional Irish dish featuring haddock, toast, and a blend of flavors, served in a mason jar. This recipe is a nostalgic and briny take on a classic Irish meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the bread into 1-inch thick slices and toast until lightly browned.
Butter the toasted bread slices with unsalted butter.
Season the haddock fillets with salt and black pepper.
Bake the haddock fillets in the oven for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Mix the lemon juice, chopped parsley, and chopped scallions in a small bowl.
To assemble, place a toasted bread slice in the bottom of a mason jar, followed by a piece of cooked haddock, and a spoonful of the lemon-parsley mixture.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a bread slice on top.
